titleEn: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas Cabin Fever
description: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: Cabin Fever is a 2023 animated Christmas comedy film directed by Luke Cormican. It is the seventh installment in the Diary of a Wimpy Kid film series, the third animated feature, and the first adaptation of Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Cabin Fever by Jeff Kinney. It is also the sequel to Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules (2022). Wesley Kimmel replaced Brady Noon as Greg Heffley, while Hunter Dillon, Erica Cerra and Chris Diamantopoulos reprised their roles as Rodrick, Susan and Frank respectively. Ethan William Childress is replaced by Spencer Howell in the role of Rowley Jefferson.
